candidate.title: scTrio-seq
candidate.scope: The middle scTrio-seq row of the supplied Illumina poster: single-cell isolation, lysis/centrifugation and RNA, direct-DNA and bisulfite-DNA tracks through sequencing and alignment. The adjacent scMT-seq and scBS-seq rows and right-hand chemical legend are context, not alternative targets. This is a schematic extraction, not a complete execution protocol. The direct-DNA track is retained as a drawing-level branch; the primary scTrio-seq implementation has an RNA-derived library and an scRRBS library, with CNVs and methylation both read from the latter.
